dialog.english:
ill finish my barrier of 
fog. I shall turn this world into 
Hell. Mwahahaha...

You get your nutrients from the
soil, so is it like your dinner?

Something like that. I wonder why
it tastes so bad...

You know, until recently this area
was part of the sea.

Huh? Over there...Mimi! Mimi, is
that you?

Huh? Over there...Mimi! Mimi, is
that you?

You could pretend to be a stuffed
animal, but I don't want my
parents to think I have bad taste.

So you're saying that I'm... in
bad taste?

Ah! Don't think too much about it.
Heehee.
What are you up to at this hour?

Oh, no real reason... oh, to pick
you up! You're back late today.

The train was delayed by all the
fog. Okay, let's go home.

Mama! Did you come to pick me up
as well?

Yeah! I finished making dinner, so
I came right away to get you!

So what's on the menu for today,
Mama?

Kimchi fried rice, topped with
strawberries and whipped cream!

Be sure to eat 'til you're
stuffed!

Ugh, how long do I have to keep
hiding?

54 percent. It's the lowest score
I've gotten in all eleven years of
my life...

Cheer up! Life's got its ups and
downs.

I've been stuck here all day, I
need to call home...

That's weird. There's no dial
tone.

Wait 'til tomorrow. I'll call the
others, and we'll go save her.

Hikari, Taichi can't sleep either.
Be patient for now and try to get
some rest.

Don't worry, your big bro will
take care of it!

Mr. Ishida, we've got trouble! Our
signal isn't reaching anywhere!

The cause is unknown. The only
thing the broadcasting system's
showing is the fog.

Land lines and cell phone lines
won't connect. Where are you
going?

Isn't it obvious? To investigate!
That's our job!

It's only covering Odaiba, and
it's a tight cover at that...

I think we might want to head back
to the station sometime around
now...

Could there be some kind of
connection between the fog and the
monster incidents?

That's weird, nobody's picking up
at all...

Hey, Taichi. Don't you have to
leave for morning practice?

I have something else to deal with
right now!

See? Your teammates came to get
you.

Per Lord Vamdemon's orders, we're
bringing all of you in!

Resistance is futile! Come, we'll
bring you to Lord Vamdemon!

I'm sorry, Taichi! I promise I'll
save your mom when I get the 
chance! But we have to run away!

I'm not joking. Hikari is the
eighth Chosen Child.

Anyway, what the heck happened to
you?

My old man woke me up and told me
to hide here.

He says the fog's covering all of 
Odaiba, and it's preventing us 
from contacting the outside world.

You mean all of Odaiba's been cut
off from the outside world?

Yeah. It's probably because of
Vamdemon.

So he's cutting off Odaiba so he
can get his hands on Hikari?

And kidnapping adults and children
left and right...

No! It's not your fault, it's
Vamdemon's!

Listen, Hikari. Stay right here
and leave this to your big bro.

Yamato! I can leave Hikari to you,
right?

Hikari, I'll be sure to save Mom
and the others!

Yeah, leave it to me. Let's go,
Agumon!

Ah, I was careless. I used up all
our supply of soy sauce...

Y-y...you, aren't you Sora's
stuffed animal! Except you're
not...

Where does Sora have her morning
practice?

The schoolyard at the elementary
school...

I have to go there! Sora is in
danger!

This is... Sora's hat. I was too
late...

Looks like Vamdemon brought all
the kidnapped humans here.
Let's go inside and look for her.

This might be a strange question,
but... about Sora. Has she ever 
said that she hates me?

Neeeeever! Sora said that she was
able to understand your love.

What's he up to, bringing all
these people here?
Hey, Mimi, can I stop hiding now?

No! If they find you, they might
separate us.

Mimi?! Mimi, did they get you,
too?

Yeah. And Papa and Mama, to
boot...

So you're here too, Palmon. We're
surrounded by enemies, so let's
just keep an eye out for now.

That big orange dinosaur could
have eaten our children by now...

That dinosaur is on our side! I'm
sure he'll come to rescue us.

Are we all clear? The men will
take out the guards...

while the women and children will
use the diversion to escape.

Um... please don't let my husband
engage in such dangerous behavior!

Be quiet, dear! There are already
a loooooot of men here!

If my husband were to die here,
I'd have to join him in the
afterlife!!

Okay, okay, got it. Please escort
the women, Mr. Tachikawa.

Oh, Sakurada? He listens to a
sutra whenever he gets too
stressed out.
A sutra. Come to think of it...

When we met some Bakemon on File
Island, Jou used a sutra to weaken
their power!

Are you trying to make a run for
it?
We did it! We made it out!

I, I... I have to keep my pride as
a maaaaaaaan!
I'm sick of just waiting around!

Why are they doing this? This is
horrible! I can't let those
Digimon get away with this!

No, you're not. You're really
pretty! And cute!

Hey, Mimi. Your pure heart is what
made me evolve, and I want to
protect it!

Good boy, good boy! Now he won't
be our enemy anymore!

What a clever trick you've pulled
there!

Hahaha. All I did was dispose of
some trash that was taking up too
much space. You're next!

Hahaha... You're cute when you're
quiet...
Take Lilimon and get out of here!

Why don't you pray to Buddha for a
peaceful death instead?
I won't let you do that!
I'll be fine! Get out of here!

Mom! Mimi! I promise I'll come
back here and save you!

Mom, Dad, I don't know when the
Bakemon will return...

Please remain here for now. You'll
be safe within the digital
barrier.

Gennai said that the fog barrier 
around Odaiba is centered at the 
TV station, so I'm headed there.

...There's nothing I can say
that'll stop you from leaving, is
there...

Let's believe in Koushirou. He's
our son! He's come this far,
right?

Be careful. You'll be sure to come
back safely, right? You'll come
back to us...

The center of the fog barrier
should be in this TV station. 
If we can just get rid of it...
Are we gon' be okay by ourselves?
This is bad. Let's go back.

Oh, no! We're surrounded on both
sides!

I thought I could take the water
bus home, but they've delayed all
the departures...

Takeru! Did you come here by
yourself?

No, I came with my mom! And got
separated from her on the way...

I see. Makes sense, in this
crowd...
Why aren't you in Odaiba, Jou?

Something happened while I was at
cram school.

But I'm going to return to Odaiba,
no matter what.

I'll go, too! But how will we get
there?

We're counting on you, Gomamon. I
need you to evolve to Ikkakumon!

Takeru, get down from there! It's
dangerous!

It's okay, Mama! This is
Ikkakumon! He's our friend!

U-Um, nice to meet you! I'm Jou
Kido, a sixth-grader!

I'll take responsibility for
Takeru, so don't worry!
Let's go find Yamato and Daddy!

Takeru, are you seasick? If you
don't feel good, let me know right
away.

Jou, you're acting kinda like my
mom.

I made a promise to your mother
when we left her at Hinode Pier...

I said I'd be responsible for
watching over you.

Hey, Jou! You're worrying too
much.

Did something over there move just
now?

We're in trouble! Jou fell into
the ocean!

Because I promised your mother
that I'd protect you...

You finally evolved! You saved us,
Zudomon!

Hey, look! The light from Jou's
Crest is cutting a hole through
the fog!

Okay! We'll get through that fog
before the hole closes up! Let's 
go, Zudomon!

I can't tell what's left and right
anymore.

I can't see him very well, is he
drifting around?

Are you one of Vamdemon's
minions?!
Look! It's a Tag and Crest.

This is the ori...ginal... eighth
child's...

Tell me! Where'd you take
everyone?!

The International Exhibition
Center! Vamdemon's trapped
everyone in there!

No! Why you, Vamdemon... Sora, go
take Yamato there!

It's almost been two hours since
Taichi left. What's he up to?

Taichi told me you'd be here!
Vamdemon's holding everyone at the
International Exhibition Center!

If I defeat you, finding the
eighth child won't matter anymore!
You'll meet your end here!

It's just gonna keep dragging on
forever!

I'm the eighth child. I'll go
wherever you want, just stop
hurting everyone!

What noble intentions. As you
wish...

Taichi was relying on me to
protect Hikari...

Yamato! Regretting it won't
accomplish anything. We have to
save Hikari!
